title: Finitely generated subextension transport at the generic residue field
statement: Under the hypotheses of separableExtension_bot_residueField, every finitely generated intermediate field F of the zero-prime residue field is separably generated over k.

proof.text: Construct the corresponding intermediate field in the fraction field through the canonical residue-field/fraction-field identification and transport separable generation.

mathlib_searches.query: separability of a residue field at the zero prime of a domain via its fraction field
mathlib_searches.results: No direct theorem found; only general separability and residue-field APIs.

mathlib_searches.query: Ideal.ResidueField fraction field zero prime IsSeparableExtension

mathlib_searches.results: General IsSeparableExtension definition exists, but no canonical zero-prime residue-field separability transfer theorem.
